summary.text: Rachel Peace is a communications consultant from the Jersey Shore who founded Hyperfocused Communications in 2022 and says she is a single mother. She is the Democratic nominee for NJ-4, having advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary, and has not previously held elected office. She is campaigning on healthcare access and affordability, childcare, and campaign-finance reform.

paragraphs.text: Says she was born and raised at the Jersey Shore; graduated from Brick Township Memorial High School, where she describes her theatrical roots as beginning.
Earned a B.A. in Public Relations, with minors in Drama and Sociology, from Hofstra University in 2014.

Describes early jobs as a certified recreational soccer referee from age 12, minimum-wage work at Wendy's and pizza parlors, and babysitting and daycare work; during college she worked on-campus security and event jobs and held internships, and graduated with a job lined up in public relations.
Earlier in her career worked on NYC Broadway Week, according to her campaign survey.
Founded Hyperfocused Communications in 2022, offering media relations and content marketing to founders, nonprofits, and startups.
Says she has contributed to efforts to curb pollution and protect open spaces, and describes herself as a public servant rather than a politician.
Says she and her five-year-old son are recipients of NJ FamilyCare, the state's low-cost health coverage program.
